parameters.content:
## Haggerty App Health Check

Hourly, at :07. Feeds the Health tab on the Marketing Dashboard (Liam only).

**Read-only toward every app.** Every call to a site, Supabase or n8n is a GET. The one write is `app_health_record()` in haggerty-marketing, into the Health tab's own tables.

### Its own credentials (create these, then pick them on each node)
1. **App Health - Supabase Management token**: Header Auth, name `Authorization`, value `Bearer sbp_...` (Supabase, Account, Access Tokens).
2. **App Health - n8n API key**: n8n API credential, base URL `https://haggertybuilds.app.n8n.cloud/api/v1`, key from Settings, n8n API (made by the owner, so it sees every project).
3. **App Health - Marketing Supabase (service role)**: Supabase API credential for haggerty-marketing.

### Email
Only when an app turns red. Nothing while it stays red.

### Mapping
Workflows are matched to apps by name through `app_registry.workflow_names`. A workflow under no app shows on **Other n8n workflows**.
